# Title: GroupDocs.Signature for .NET – API to Sign, Verify, and Remove Document Signatures

GroupDocs.Signature for .NET is a powerful library to create, apply, verify, and remove digital and electronic signatures from documents including PDFs, Word, Excel, Images, and more. Supports text, image, barcode, QR code, stamp, metadata, and certificate-based digital signatures.

## About

This repository contains examples and demos for GroupDocs.Signature for .NET, a comprehensive digital signature API that enables .NET developers to automate signing, verifying, and processing electronic and digital signatures in over 90 document types.

**Key Features:**
- Digital signatures with X.509 certificates
- Image, text, barcode, QR code signatures  
- Metadata and form field signatures
- Signature verification and removal
- Cross-platform support (.NET Framework 4.6.2+, .NET 6, .NET 8 and .NET 10 on Windows, Linux and macOS)

## How the examples are organized

- `Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/` - the shared example code (C# 7.3): one class per example, each with a static `Run()` method, in `QuickStart/`, `BasicUsage/` and `AdvancedUsage/`.
- `Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp.Framework/`, `.Net/`, `.Net8/` and `.Net10/` - console projects for .NET Framework 4.6.2, .NET 6, .NET 8 and .NET 10; `RunExamples.cs` lists the examples to run.
- `Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/Resources/SampleFiles/` - sample documents and test certificates; `Constants.cs` holds their paths and `LicensePath`.

## Examples added for version 26.9

- [SkipExternalResourcesWhenLoading](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Loading/SkipExternalResourcesWhenLoading.cs) - external resources that a document links to are skipped by default
- [LoadWhitelistedExternalResources](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Loading/LoadWhitelistedExternalResources.cs) - load external resources from trusted addresses only (`LoadOptions.WhitelistedResources`)
- [SignWithDigitalAdvancedPdfHashAlgorithm](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Sign/SignWithDigitalAdvanced/SignWithDigitalAdvancedPdfHashAlgorithm.cs) - PDF digital signature with SHA-512 (`HashAlgorithm`; SHA-256 is the default)
- [SignWithDigitalExpiredCertificate](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Sign/SignWithDigitalAdvanced/SignWithDigitalExpiredCertificate.cs) - expired certificates are rejected unless `DigitalSignOptions.AllowExpired` is set
- [SignWithDigitalPostQuantumCertificate](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Sign/SignWithDigitalAdvanced/SignWithDigitalPostQuantumCertificate.cs) - sign a Word document with a post-quantum ML-DSA certificate
- [VerifyPdfWithDigital](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Verify/VerifyPdfWithDigital.cs) - verify a PDF digital signature by certificate subject, issuer and reason
- [ConsoleLoggingWithLogLevels](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Logging/ConsoleLoggingWithLogLevels.cs) - choose which messages are logged (`SignatureSettings.LogLevel`)
- [SignWithTextFontStyles](https://github.com/groupdocs-signature/GroupDocs.Signature-for-.NET/blob/master/Examples/GroupDocs.Signature.Examples.CSharp/AdvancedUsage/Sign/SignWithTextFontStyles.cs) - font styles with `SignatureFont`
